authority.note: This packet frames required adversarial reviews; script generation never answers or decides them.

limitations: Evidence context is assembled mechanically and may include irrelevant rows; the reviewer must judge relevance.
A pending red-team prompt is not a judgment_review and cannot support an M6 decision.
No script-authored verdict or recommendation is permitted.
Priority weights allocate review attention only.
Later judgment must preserve Commander-first identity and bracket-specific context.

reviews.adversarial_challenge: Assume multiple permanent types are answered over several turns. Identify which strategic routes actually rebuild and which collapse after repeated removal.

value: No Heartless Summoning (L38) or slow recursion engines (L36).

blueprint_failure_modes.description: Sauron costs eight; slow without fast mana.
Graveyard hate stops the trigger's best mode and the backup reanimation.

value.interaction: Force of Will, Mana Drain, Swan Song, Deadly Rollick, Feed the Swarm, Cyclonic Rift, Toxic Deluge, Blasphemous Act.
value.mana: 32 lands with Mountain and Island types for Anger/Wonder; fast mana.
value.protection: Deflecting Swat, Lightning Greaves, Force of Will.

accepted_role.advances_plan: Sauron's cast trigger is the deck's best reanimation spell, and Command Beacon recasts it without tax.
accepted_role.honest_note: Commander-native but expensive: eight mana, and Spellbook finds no combos. The source calls the engine value/reanimation rather than a compact win (blueprint L21). The deck can win without him through cheap reanimation of Archon, Valgavoth or Jin-Gitaxias. Expect mid Bracket 4. M1 review (sauronlotr-01..05, all verified) confirms the cast trigger and reanimation rules.
